packageName: TalkNTypeAI Pan-India Legal Template Import Package
importNotes: Mapped to a DraftTemplate-style record shape using title, slug, category, country, state, language, description, status, version, fields and templateBody.
Records are set to draft to avoid accidental publication during import.
Slugs are generated from category plus title to reduce collisions across repeated titles in different categories.
Before running the importer, confirm your actual Mongoose schema and importer match these fields.
Use a staging database or backup first. Existing importer may upsert by slug or by title+category; verify before importing.
These are editable general drafting frameworks, not legally verified or filing-ready documents.
